formula: pmax(numpos, 2) ~ religion + year + age + gender + (1 | respond), cumulative logit
notes: Hand pass #82: MLMUS4 exercise 11.5 (ex11_5_abortion.do) fits meologit score i.religion i.year age male || person: after recode score 0/2=2; score, person and male are numpos, respond and gender here. Part 3d refits it with standard errors clustered on district, which gets no random effect. The merge of scores 0-2 lives in the formula only, so the row keeps all eight levels. The CMM software review fits a respondent-intercept ordered logit with religion only; Goldstein (1995, section 3.2) fits a three-level Normal model to normal scores.
